sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: irender-ui-kit is a set of components in the style of shadcn/ui for iRender documents. Each one is plain configuration: a type, props, and the usual attrs, style, parts and on. The kit sets defaults only, so a document can override any attribute, style or inner part. Colours, radius, spacing and fonts come from theme tokens, so the whole kit follows a theme, dark mode included.

sections.title: Theming
sections.summary: The kit reads its colours, radius, density, text size and font from theme tokens. Theme options let people choose between sets of them on the page, and the choice is kept and applied before the page shows, on every page that uses the kit. The light and dark mode is a theme option too.

sections.title: Button
sections.summary: A button in seven variants and four sizes, with an optional icon. With href it renders a link that looks like a button. Its on.click runs any actions.

sections.title: Split button
sections.summary: A primary action joined to an arrow that opens a menu of related ones, such as Download PDF with Excel and CSV in the menu.

sections.title: Toggle, toggle group and slider
sections.summary: A toggle is a button that stays pressed. A toggle group presses one option (or several with multiple). A slider picks a number in a range. All three keep their value in state through bind.

sections.title: Form controls
sections.summary: Inputs, text areas, selects, checkboxes, switches and radio groups, styled to match. bind keeps a state key in sync both ways; name makes them work in a plain form.

sections.title: Field, input group and button group
sections.summary: A field lays out a label, a control, help text and an error, and wires them together for screen readers. An input group puts text or buttons inside a field's border. A button group joins buttons into one control.

sections.title: Combobox
sections.summary: A searchable select in the style of react-select: one or many values, groups, options loaded as you type, creatable values, fixed values, and the WAI-ARIA combobox keyboard.
sections.usage:
- type: ui-combobox
  props:
    bind: flavours
    multiple: true
    clearable: true
    options: [{ value: vanilla, label: Vanilla }, { label: Fruity, options: [mango, lime] }]
- { type: ui-combobox, props: { bind: city, searchUrl: /api/cities, placeholder: Search cities… } }

sections.title: One-time code
sections.summary: A code in a row of boxes, for two-step sign-in or confirming an email. Typing, pasting and the phone's suggestion of a code from a message all work, as one field for the keyboard and screen readers. The pattern keeps out what doesn't belong, and a complete event fires when the last box fills.

sections.title: Date picker and calendar
sections.summary: Pick a day (with a time), a month, a quarter or a year; one, a range or several. Limits, disabled days, presets, financial years and typing the date are props. bindRange gives the exact dates picked, ready for a chart's or a table's filter.

sections.title: Badge and kbd
sections.summary: A badge is a small status label; kbd shows a key or shortcut.
sections.usage:
- { type: ui-badge, props: { text: New, variant: secondary } }
- { type: ui-kbd, props: { text: ⌘K } }

sections.title: Card
sections.summary: A bordered panel with an optional title and description. Put a card footer last for its actions.

sections.title: Avatar and aspect ratio
sections.summary: An avatar shows a picture, or initials when there's none. An aspect ratio keeps its children at a fixed shape as the width changes.

sections.title: Table
sections.summary: A styled HTML table in a scrolling container. Its children are the table's rows and sections, so a list with tag: tbody fills it from data or state. For sorting, filters and paging, use the data table.

sections.title: Data table
sections.summary: A table over rows with sorting, column filters, search, paging or infinite scroll, rows from an API, virtual rows, nested rows, pinned columns, selection with bulk actions, detail rows and summaries. Its filters are the chart kit's, so tables and charts filter each other.

sections.title: Typography and separator
sections.summary: Headings in four levels, text in variants from lead to code and blockquote, and a separator line, plain or with a label in the middle.

sections.title: Alert
sections.summary: A callout for a short, important message, with an icon, a title and a description. The destructive variant is for errors.
sections.usage: - { type: ui-alert, props: { title: Heads up!, description: You can add components with the CLI., icon: "ℹ" } }

sections.title: Toast
sections.summary: A message that shows for a few seconds at the bottom of the screen. Put one toaster on the page, bound to a state key; setting that key to a title and description shows a toast.

sections.title: Illustrations, error pages and empty states
sections.summary: Drawings for error pages and empty states: not found, server error, forbidden, maintenance, offline, no data, no results, out of stock, an empty cart or inbox, no notifications, an expired session, a failed payment, coming soon and all done. They're coloured by the theme's primary colour and its second brand colour, with neutrals mixed from the text and background, so they follow the palette, custom colours and dark mode. Give ui-empty an illustration for an empty state; the blocks have whole error pages.

sections.title: Progress and skeleton
sections.summary: A progress bar for a task's completion, and skeletons that stand in for content while it loads.
sections.usage:
- { type: ui-progress, props: { value: "{{ progress }}" } }
- { type: ui-skeleton, props: { width: 240, height: 16 } }

sections.title: Spinner, empty state and scroll area
sections.summary: A spinner says something is loading. An empty state fills a page or list with nothing in it yet. A scroll area scrolls its children with a thin, themed scrollbar.

sections.title: Dialog, alert dialog and sheet
sections.summary: A modal dialog opened by its trigger; an alert dialog that only its own buttons close; and a sheet that slides in from an edge. A dialog close button closes the one it's in, and runs its own actions too.

sections.title: Popover, dropdown menu, tooltip and hover card
sections.summary: Floating content next to its trigger: a popover for anything, a dropdown menu of actions with the menu keyboard, a tooltip on hover or focus, and a hover card for a preview.

sections.title: Context menu
sections.summary: A menu opened with a right-click (or Shift+F10, or the menu key) on its area, at the pointer. bind gets what was right-clicked: the nearest data-context value, or a data table's row.

sections.title: Command palette
sections.summary: A search box over a list of actions, filtered as you type, inline or in a dialog opened with a shortcut such as ⌘K.

sections.title: Tabs, accordion and collapsible
sections.summary: Tabs switch between panels, with the open one in state. An accordion opens one section at a time (or several with multiple), and a collapsible shows and hides one, both on native details.

sections.title: Menubar and submenus
sections.summary: A bar of menus, as at the top of an application. Left and Right move along the bar, and an open menu follows; Down opens a menu; hovering moves between open menus. Any menu can hold submenus, checkbox items and radio items.

sections.title: Navigation menu
sections.summary: A site's navigation: links, and items that open a panel of links (or anything else) on hover or click. Down opens a panel and moves into it, Escape closes it, and Left and Right move along the bar.

sections.title: Breadcrumb and pagination
sections.summary: A breadcrumb shows where a page sits, the last item being the current page. Pagination links pages, with the page and page count from data or state.
sections.usage:
- { type: ui-breadcrumb, props: { items: [{ label: Home, href: / }, { label: Settings }] } }
- { type: ui-pagination, props: { page: "{{ page }}", pages: 12, href: "?page={{ p }}" } }

sections.title: Sidebar
sections.summary: A whole-page layout with a sidebar that collapses to icons or slides away, opens as a sheet on a phone, and toggles with ⌘B. Items can hold sub-menus, icons and badges.
sections.usage:
- type: ui-sidebar-layout
  props: { bind: sidebar, collapsible: icon }
  children:
    - type: ui-sidebar
      children:
        - type: ui-sidebar-content
          children:
            - type: ui-sidebar-group
              props: { label: Platform }
              children: [ { type: ui-sidebar-item, props: { label: Dashboard, icon: grid, href: /, active: true } } ]
    - { type: ui-sidebar-trigger }

sections.title: Chat
sections.summary: A conversation log, message bubbles with threads and UI in them, a typing indicator, and an input that sends to an endpoint and streams the reply in.
sections.usage:
- { type: ui-conversation, props: { messages: "{{ chat }}", typing: "{{ waiting }}" } }
- { type: ui-chat-input, props: { messages: chat, waiting: waiting, endpoint: /api/chat } }

sections.title: Carousel
sections.summary: Slides in a row that scroll sideways and snap to each one, with arrow buttons, keys and swiping. Chat replies use it for a set of cards.
